targets.queryText: SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='ORB' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS ORB, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='PULLBACK' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS PULLBACK, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='MOMENTUM' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS MOMENTUM, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='REVERSION' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS REVERSION, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='RETEST' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS RETEST, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='SWEEP' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS SWEEP, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='FVG' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS FVG, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='GAPGO' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS GAPGO, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='unassigned' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS LEGACY FROM trades WHERE agent='day' AND side='sell' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='ORB' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS ORB, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='PULLBACK' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS PULLBACK, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='MOMENTUM' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS MOMENTUM, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='REVERSION' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS REVERSION, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='RETEST' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS RETEST, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='SWEEP' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS SWEEP, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='FVG' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS FVG, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='GAPGO' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS GAPGO, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strat='unassigned' THEN realized ELSE 0 END),2) AS LEGACY FROM trades WHERE agent='day' AND side='sell' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

targets.queryText: SELECT ts AS time, symbol, CASE WHEN strat='unassigned' THEN 'LEGACY (pre-team)' ELSE strat END AS strategy, ROUND(qty,4) AS qty, ROUND(realized,2) AS pnl, ROUND(100.0*realized/NULLIF(value-realized,0),2) AS return_pct, reason FROM trades WHERE agent='day' AND side='sell' AND realized>0 ORDER BY realized DESC LIMIT 10

targets.queryText: SELECT symbol, strat, COALESCE(kind,'cash_secured_put/covered_call') AS kind, short_strike, long_strike, expiry, qty, ROUND(credit,2) AS credit, ROUND(mark,2) AS mark, ROUND(open_pnl,2) AS open_pnl, ROUND(max_loss,2) AS max_loss, ROUND(collateral,2) AS collateral FROM options ORDER BY expiry, symbol
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT symbol, strat, COALESCE(kind,'cash_secured_put/covered_call') AS kind, short_strike, long_strike, expiry, qty, ROUND(credit,2) AS credit, ROUND(mark,2) AS mark, ROUND(open_pnl,2) AS open_pnl, ROUND(max_loss,2) AS max_loss, ROUND(collateral,2) AS collateral FROM options ORDER BY expiry, symbol

panels.description: An empty table is expected when there are no open options positions. This sleeve only opens cash-secured puts, covered calls, or fully hedged put credit spreads; naked options are not allowed.

panels.title: Team budget by weekly review (% of account)

targets.queryText: SELECT ts AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN agent='growth' THEN budget_pct ELSE 0 END),1) AS growth, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN agent='options' THEN budget_pct ELSE 0 END),1) AS options, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN agent='day' THEN budget_pct ELSE 0 END),1) AS day FROM allocation WHERE current=0 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN agent='growth' THEN budget_pct ELSE 0 END),1) AS growth, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN agent='options' THEN budget_pct ELSE 0 END),1) AS options, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN agent='day' THEN budget_pct ELSE 0 END),1) AS day FROM allocation WHERE current=0 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Current allocation and last weekly score

targets.queryText: SELECT agent, ROUND(budget_pct,1) AS budget_pct_of_account, ROUND(mult,2) AS multiplier_vs_base, ROUND(score_pct,3) AS last_week_pnl_pct_of_account, datetime(ts,'unixepoch','localtime') AS reviewed FROM allocation WHERE current=1 ORDER BY agent
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT agent, ROUND(budget_pct,1) AS budget_pct_of_account, ROUND(mult,2) AS multiplier_vs_base, ROUND(score_pct,3) AS last_week_pnl_pct_of_account, datetime(ts,'unixepoch','localtime') AS reviewed FROM allocation WHERE current=1 ORDER BY agent

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT rank, name, tier, parts, train_n, train_excess_bp, train_t, hold_n, hold_excess_bp, hold_t, ROUND(hold_hit*100,1) AS hold_hit_pct, hold_pf, weight FROM ranking WHERE parts=2 AND rank<=25 OR parts=1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN parts=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, rank

panels.title: Desk briefing: previous day, week and history per team (what the historian hands each team)
panels.description: Built from closed trades. 'avoid' symbols are skipped and 'favored' symbols get a small ranking bonus when a team reviews candidates; both need enough recent closed trades.

targets.queryText: SELECT team, period, closed, ROUND(net,2) AS net_pnl, ROUND(win_rate,0) AS win_rate_pct, ROUND(profit_factor,2) AS profit_factor, best, worst, avoid, favored FROM briefing ORDER BY CASE team WHEN 'growth' THEN 1 WHEN 'options' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE period WHEN 'yesterday' THEN 1 WHEN 'week' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT team, period, closed, ROUND(net,2) AS net_pnl, ROUND(win_rate,0) AS win_rate_pct, ROUND(profit_factor,2) AS profit_factor, best, worst, avoid, favored FROM briefing ORDER BY CASE team WHEN 'growth' THEN 1 WHEN 'options' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE period WHEN 'yesterday' THEN 1 WHEN 'week' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
